frozen_analysis.chromatic_control: CLK products are ionosphere-free combinations and cannot alone establish chromaticity; a future raw multi-frequency RINEX lane must compare E1/E5a/E5b with plasma TEC controls
frozen_analysis.epoch_grid: exact intersection of CLK epochs with SP3 epochs; no interpolation; exclude first and last common epoch of each daily file
frozen_analysis.instantaneous_template: weak-field Earth monopole potential plus special-relativistic v^2/(2c^2), with sign and any already-applied product correction resolved from the pinned format/technical note before opening CLK rows
frozen_analysis.likelihood: Gaussian generalized least squares with one AR(1) coefficient and innovation variance estimated on E14 development days only for each frozen tau; nuisance and beta fit on six leave-one-day-in folds, predictive log likelihood accumulated on the omitted E14 day; tau selected once by E14 total; all coefficients including beta and tau then frozen for E18 and circular controls
frozen_analysis.memory_template: causal exponential convolution of the registered instantaneous source template minus the instantaneous template; initialize each PRN from the unique periodic fixed point obtained source-only from its first complete SP3 orbital cycle, then propagate continuously across all seven days with no daily reset
nuisance_design: per-PRN per-day intercept and linear drift in fractional-frequency response
SP3 orbit-error proxy if supplied by product metadata
solar-radiation-pressure/orbital systematic templates only if frozen from source-only metadata before CLK access
no temperature or magnetic proxy imputation when unavailable
circular-control PRN indicators with shared processing terms
frozen_analysis.primary_statistic: E18 minus-null predictive log-likelihood difference for the frozen E14-selected causal-memory model
frozen_analysis.promotion_boundary: development falsifier only because the public manifest lacks onboard temperature/magnetic series and individual-clock identity; no discovery claim can pass on this source alone
required_sign_checks: E14 development beta has one sign in at least six of seven leave-one-day fits
E18 holdout beta-free prediction improves over null without amplitude or tau refit
neither selected circular control shows an equal-or-larger standardized causal quadrature
phase-scrambled source histories do not match or exceed the real registered source history
frozen_analysis.response: first finite difference of satellite clock offset divided by exact epoch separation, computed only after source and response receipts
source_units: two lowest-eccentricity eligible Galileo PRNs selected from SP3 geometry before any CLK rows are opened
